text:
kevin_partnerships: Kicking off OrbitHub joint POC — they want a shared pilot (2 wks) with SAML SSO + VPC peering. Need to confirm infra & pricing. Any immediate blockers?

anya_sales: Thanks Kevin. OrbitHub expects ~5k req/day during pilot. Pricing question: do we recommend hosted sandbox or a short reserved for pilot? They asked for an "all-in" quote.

rita_se: Prefer a dedicated tenant for data isolation in prod, but for pilot we can do hosted sandbox with stricter entitlements. For SAML, we support SP-initiated SAML2.0 and OIDC. We need their IdP metadata + redirect_uris. VPC peering requires partner CIDR + netops contact.

sam_eng: Quick capacity note — we have limited dedicated GPU capacity in eu-west right now. Can provision but ~48h lead time for the GPU pool. Hosted sandbox in eu-west is doable immediately.

kevin_partnerships: Okay. I'll ask OrbitHub for IdP metadata and their infra contact. Can we create a hosted tenant in eu-west with token-scoped access while we provision dedicated?

rita_se: Yes — hosted tenant w/ per-route entitlements and no prefix caching is feasible. We'll restrict model access to a small set (e.g., redwood-llama-7b-quant) for the pilot. Need to add their admin emails to the tenant.

maria_ops: Note on egress: if outbound bandwidth >1TB during pilot we will bill partner unless rolled into the committed pricing. Estimated egress delta ~ $0.09/GB (cloud estimate). Recommend calling this out in the quote.

anya_sales: :thumbsup: I'll include an explicit egress line item. Ballpark suggestion: hosted pilot + 2-week reserved spin-up -> recommend a temporary reserved of 2k RU/day, then convert to monthly reserved if they go to prod. I'll draft numbers and share.

sam_eng: Config snippet for the hosted tenant we can use for onboarding (paste into infra ticket):

```
tenant: orbithub-pilot-eu-west
region: eu-west-1
models_allowed:
  - redwood-llama-7b-quant
entitlements:
  prefix_cache: false
  max_tokens_per_request: 2048
admins:
  - ops@orbit.example.com
```

deploy-bot: sandbox-orbithub-243210 created in eu-west-1 — credentials vaulted in Secrets Manager (link: https://secrets.example.com/keys/sandbox-orbithub-243210)

rita_se: Security asks: they sent a short PEN test and want our KMS + key rotation policy. Also asked for SOC2 doc. I can attach SOC2 summary to the packet. If they require HSM-backed keys, that's +2 weeks for provision and contractual amendment.

kevin_partnerships: Blocking list for tomorrow's call: 1) IdP metadata 2) partner CIDR + infra contact 3) egress billing confirmation. Can we get these by EOD?

anya_sales: I'll own the pricing deck. Can we sync 3pm PT today? I'll send invite.

sam_eng: 3pm PT works. I'll bring eu-west spin-up timeline, estimated GPU cost, and fallback plan (hosted sandbox).

maria_ops: Also flag: if they want audit logs exported to their SIEM via S3, that requires a shared bucket and ACLs — will need legal OK on data export.

kevin_partnerships: Great — TY everyone. @orbit_contact (external) if you can drop IdP metadata + cidr + infra contact in this thread that'll speed things up.

anya_sales: I'll DM OrbitHub and post updates here.

rita_se: Adding checklist for 3pm call in thread: - IdP metadata received - CIDR + netops contact - Confirmed models for pilot - Egress billing line item - SOC2 + KMS notes ready

kevin_partnerships: Perfect. See you at 3pm.
